items.name: Customs House
items.notes: Weighs and taxes goods crossing the bridge.

items.name: Gate Watch Post
items.notes: Checks travellers entering on Pilgrim Road.

items.name: Inn
items.notes: Inn on Pilgrim Road by the market.

items.name: Lockup
items.notes: Cells, kept beside the warden's hall.

items.name: Meeting Hall
items.notes: Plain hall for town meetings; no religious use.

items.name: Mill
items.notes: Water mill on the river bank (mill-race site; slope limit relaxed 1.6x for the bank).

items.name: Smithy
items.notes: Forge near water, away from the thatched core.

items.name: Tax and Permit Office
items.notes: Tolls, permits and levies, first stop on the road into the centre.

items.name: Town Treasury
items.notes: Strong room for levies and fines, next to the hall.

items.name: Warden's Hall
items.notes: Seat of the wardens, on the low rise. Layout proposed.

items.name: Wardens' Barracks
items.notes: Quarters for the wardens' watch, beside the hall.
